name: Barton & Gray Mariners Club
verdict: A private US membership yachting club run by its founders. Nothing found.
note: Official Team Supplier of the U.S. SailGP Team (ussailgpteam.com, 16 Jun 2025). Rating note (2026-09-30): founded in 2006 and led by Timothy Barton and Douglas Gray per its own About page; its share register isn't public, no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
